title: A型バリケード
description: 工事現場や通行止めで使う、樹脂製のA型バリケードです。左右のA字脚と開き止め、上部の黄色と黒の交互帯の横木、下段の横木、中央の白い反射板、脚先のパッドを造形しています。文字・注意書き・連結金具・点滅灯は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.190 × 0.809 × 0.540 m、1,716三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A plastic A-type barricade used at roadworks and closures. It models two A-frame legs with spreaders, a top beam with alternating yellow and black segments, a lower rail, a white center reflector and foot pads. Lettering, warnings, coupling hardware and flashing lamps are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.190 × 0.809 × 0.540 m; 1,716 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
